traits.name: Undetectable
traits.text: (abjuration, primal); A sea serpent automatically tries to counteract any detection, revelation, or scrying divination attempted against it, using its Stealth modifier for its counteract modifier.

traits.name: Capsize
traits.text: ⬻ (attack); The sea serpent attempts to capsize an aquatic vessel of its size or smaller that it's adjacent to. It must succeed at an Athletics check with a DC of 35 or the pilot's Sailing Lore DC, whichever is higher.

traits.name: Sea Serpent Algae
traits.text: (incapacitation, poison); Saving Throw DC 34 Fortitude. Maximum Duration 6 rounds Stage 1 confused and, if flying, spends its first action each turn to descend 20 feet (1 round) Stage 1 confused and, if flying, descends until reaching the ground or water below (1 round)

traits.name: Spine Rake
traits.text: ⬺ (attack, move); The sea serpent extends the spines along its back and Swims or Strides. Each creature the serpent is adjacent to at any point during its movement takes 4d6+8 (4d6+8) slashing damage (DC 32 basic Reflex save).

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ jaws +27 (reach 20 feet); Damage 3d10+14 (3d10+14) piercing plus Grab

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ tail +27 (agile, reach 30 feet); Damage 2d10+14 (2d10+14) bludgeoning plus Grab

actions.name: Ranged
actions.text: ⬻ water spout +25 (brutal, range increment 100 feet, water); Damage 2d6+12 (2d6+12) bludgeoning plus sea serpent algae
